title: CUET UG 2026 Examination
description: The Common University Entrance Test (CUET) is a national-level entrance exam conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to undergraduate (UG) and postgraduate (PG) programs at all central universities and various participating state, deemed, and private universities in India. It provides a single-window opportunity for students to apply to multiple central universities with one exam, focusing on 12th-grade NCERT-based knowledge to offer equal opportunities.
